text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll cast my very best spell, just for<n>you! Every
princess needs a witch,<n>after all.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Magic for a princess! Wait, are you<n>about to
summon a pumpkin<n>carriage?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, then you just need a nice dress,<n>and you'll be
set.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
My magic isn't for summoning things<n>or other
mundane tricks like that! It's<n>reserved for more
noble goals.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Noble... So like turning her into the<n>ideal princess?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... a princess with the nobility and<n>strength to
knock down everything<n>that stands in my way?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well, I do hope to someday obtain the<n>strength to
tame a wild lion with a<n>stare. or to hold up a falling
tree with<n>one finger...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But a true princess has to grow<n>stronger through
her own efforts! I<n>can't let magic do all the work!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: A w-wild lion?! A falling tree?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'd like to see what kind of training<n>that entails...
